_instructions: This file records the assessment-form comparison from the evaluation framework: for the same building-intake answers, what does Drexel's original PIPE tool output vs. what does this system's /api/assess endpoint output.

1. Pick or define a 'scenario' - one full set of answers to the 18 intake questions, representing one hypothetical building (see 'questions_reference' below for the exact question text/options/dependsOn logic - kept in sync with backend/constants.py).
2. Run that exact scenario through Drexel's original tool. Paste its raw output into scenarios[i].drexel_output.raw_report_text, plus where/when you ran it.

3. Run the identical answers through this app's assessment form (or POST the same answers to /api/assess) and paste the output into scenarios[i].pipe_output.raw_report_text, noting which retrieval mode was used.

4. Fill in comparison_notes: where do the two reports agree/disagree factually, what's cited in one but not the other, does PIPE's output cite sources Drexel's doesn't (or vice versa), anything Drexel flags that PIPE misses or hallucinates.

Duplicate the scenario block for each additional scenario you test. Recommend at least 3: a low-risk case, a high-risk case (healthcare/elderly facility with multiple risk devices), and an ambiguous/edge case (lots of 'Don't Know' answers) to see how each tool handles uncertainty.
This file is data, not code - safe to hand-edit directly.

questions_reference.text: Does your building have thermostatic mixing valves?
Is the thermostatic mixing valve centralized or are separate valves provided for individual fixtures?
What is the hot water temperature at a typical tap in your building?

How long does it take for the hot-water to reach a steady temperature from the time when the hot-water valve at a typical faucet is opened at its full capacity to the point when hot-water temperature stabilizes?
Does your building have recirculation loop?
What is the hot water temperature at the end of recirculation loop?
What type of residual disinfectant is present in the plumbing system?
What is the measured chlorine disinfectant residual level (mg/L) at a typical faucet in your plumbing system?
What is the measured chloramine disinfectant residual level (mg/L) at a typical faucet in your plumbing system?
What is the measured chlorine dioxide disinfectant residual level (mg/L) at a typical faucet in your plumbing system?
What is the water heater temperature setpoint in your building?
Does your building have dead ends?
Does your building have low flow fixtures?
Does your building have Electronic (i.e., automatic/no touch) faucets?
Does your building have Showers with flexible hoses?
Does your building have a cooling tower?
Does your building have a hot tub (also known as a spa) that is not drained between each use?
Does your building have a decorative fountain?
Does your building have a centrally-installed mister, atomizer, air washer, or humidifier?
Is your building a healthcare facility where patients stay overnight, or house/treat people with chronic/acute medical problems or weakened immune systems?
Does your building primarily house people older than 65 years?
Does your building have multiple housing units and a centralized hot water system?
Does your building have more than 10 stories (including basement levels)?
